metadata.description: Claude Code mods tuned for the Claude desktop app: a live replay of every step Claude takes, and an IDE-style file tree.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: A live timeline of everything Claude does in a turn (commands, reads, searches, edits) with diffs and output, in a pane.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree of the session folder with git status and live highlights on files Claude touches; opens in the desktop app too.
